svg.text: Development reference / sampled current terrain / north is up / includes the hidden discovery
Route overlays are guides, not painted roads. This is not an in-game map.
100 m / 100 m grid / X east, Z south
Cream: easy mainland circuits and approaches. Orange: optional rocky rides.
Cyan: Rock Passage and cliff-foot shallows. Pink: hidden inlet approach.
The map uses the same interpolated terrain as rendering and collision; props are omitted.
Solid ring = main zone · dashed = alternate approach
Exact x/z centres and radii from src/game/postcards.ts
Requires 8 m driving, grounded upright and shallow/dry.
Spawn, reset and teleport do not count as discovery.
Arrival/elevation gates also apply; rings alone are not enough.
